title: All-Star Squadron #6 DC Comics 1982 Never Step on a Feathered Serpent Hawkman
condition_description: Bright and clean with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
All-Star Squadron #6 (February 1982), DC Comics - "Never Step on a Feathered Serpent!" Hawkman, Robotman, Firebrand, Shining Knight, Doctor Mid-Nite and Hawkgirl vs. the Feathered Serpent. Rich Buckler and Jerry Ordway cover; Roy Thomas story. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Challenge #8860 Auto Chassis ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
